key_entities: untracked working tree files would be overwritten by merge
propositions: Compaction writes SNAPSHOT.json and *.retired non-atomically in a detached sweep without rollback; if the worker dies before git-commit, the working tree is left dirty with untracked files.
Union merge in _union_merge runs git merge origin/tickets; when a peer has pushed the same *.retired/SNAPSHOT paths, git aborts because those paths exist untracked in the working tree.
Reconverge abort handler is abort-only and push-recovery cannot clear untracked files (git reset --hard is tracked-only, git stash create lacks -u flag), causing permanent wedge on every retry.
Local ticket commits become stranded off origin when the store wedges, preventing writes from reaching origin/tickets until manual recovery.

The fix relocates only the untracked paths git explicitly names into <git-common-dir>/reconverge-quarantine/<ts>/ and retries the merge once, preserving both parents and keeping all local commits reachable.
